description: The line plot illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) across different epochs for various fine-tuning methods of a "tiny" Whisper model. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and uses a linear scale with visible tick marks ranging from 30 to 70 at intervals of 10. The plot contains five gray lines representing different methods. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int4" method is depicted by a solid line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 69 at epoch 0, steadily declines, and ends at roughly 36 at epoch 6. The "tiny AdaLoRA_int8" method is shown as a solid line with square markers, beginning at approximately 60 at epoch 0, declining to roughly 51 at epoch 2, and continuing downward to end at approximately 32 at epoch 6. The "tiny int4" method is represented by a dashed line with circular markers, starting at approximately 69 at epoch 0, decreasing to roughly 39 by epoch 5, and ending with a slight increase to approximately 40 at epoch 6. The "tiny int8" method is plotted as a dashed line with square markers, starting at approximately 60 at epoch 0, dropping to roughly 47 at epoch 1, and gradually declining to end at approximately 37 at epoch 6. Finally, the "tiny full" method is indicated by a dotted line with triangular markers, beginning below the lowest y-axis tick at approximately 29 at epoch 0 and exhibiting a slow, steady decline to end at roughly 23 at epoch 6.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the performance of different fine-tuning methods over several epochs, represented by the metric 'WER' (Word Error Rate) on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled 'epoch,' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with integer tick labels for each epoch. The y-axis is labeled 'WER,' with a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. The line marked with circular markers and a solid line style is color-coded in gray, representing 'tiny AdaLoRA_int4.' It starts at approximately 70 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to around 40 at epoch 6, showing a general downward trend. The line with square markers and a solid style represents 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' and follows a similar pattern, starting around 60 WER and ending below 35. The dashed line with circular markers represents 'tiny int4,' starting approximately 70 and decreasing to below 45 by epoch 6. The line with square markers and a dashed style, coded as 'tiny int8,' begins at 60, declining steadily to reach 40 at the end. Finally, the line with triangular markers and a dotted style indicates 'tiny full,' starting just below 30 and showing a slight downward trend, ending near 28 at epoch 6. Overall, the plot highlights the trajectory of WER across epochs for each method, with 'tiny AdaLoRA_int8' consistently outperforming 'tiny full' across all epochs. A legend is placed at the top right corner of the plot.
